verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no automation feature in v0, such as scheduled or triggered workflows. So there is nothing shown that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The GitHub integration provides branches, PRs and CI for project code, which is adjacent source control for generated apps rather than versioning of automations, and no rollback capability is documented at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
